rules.title: Game rules
rules.objectiveBody: Each player has a table with 5 columns. The goal is to fill every cell in each column, following its fill-order rule, for the highest total score.
rules.upperSectionBody: Score = number of dice showing that face × the face value. If the sum of all 6 rows reaches <bold>63</bold> (3 of each), you get a <bold>bonus of 50</bold>. On column S, the whole total (sum + bonus) is doubled at the end.
rules.bankBody: before a column is complete, the "Total" cell shows the difference from the normal pace (3 dice/row) — green if you're ahead, red if you're behind. The real total only appears once the column is done.
rules.catFullHouse: Full House — sum of the 5 dice + 30
rules.catFourKind: Four of a Kind — sum of the 4 matching dice + 40
rules.catLow: Low — sum of the dice, must be smaller than High
rules.catHigh: High — sum of the dice, must be larger than Low
rules.servedBody: "Served" means the combination came out on the first roll, with no reroll at all.
